entities.summary: Hannelore Baron was a German-American artist who created reminiscent and expressive collages and box constructions that blend abstraction, assemblage, and personal chronicle. Exhibited in the late 1960s, Baron's art often composed of found materials, fabric and text, earning recognition as an important artist in 20th-century mixed-media art.
